title: 第68章 诗唐吵架，杨蜜破防

第68章 诗唐吵架，杨蜜破防-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

面对糖嫣冷冰冰的质问，刘施施直接回应。

“我说的是事实。还有，别人的饭盒就那么香吗？”

“刘施施，你是不是理解能力有问题？我和魏沐真没什么。”

这句话，她说过好多次。

瞎姐不信！！

主要是糖嫣太气人，这女人和魏沐天天演情侣，在片场拉拉扯扯，还故意在她面前显摆。

说没有一点心思，谁信啊？

杨蜜坐在两人中间像个鹌鹑一样，大气不敢喘。

这个场面有些超乎她的控制范围。

如果作为场外人，那她很乐意看到俩人吵架。

但现在她是局中人，不好作壁上观。

这就像凑过去看热闹的路人，到地方才发现，特么是自己家着火。

“哎呀。大家都是一个剧组的同事。都消消气。”

不得已，杨蜜出来打圆场。

“蜜蜜，平心而论，今天不是她先惹我？”

糖嫣觉得很委屈，她今天啥都没干，平白无故被损一顿。

怎么？我年纪大吃你们家大米了？

“让她离我男朋友远一点，我就不管她。”

“呵呵....”

瞎姐瞪她一眼，然后生气的晃着杨蜜的胳膊：“你看看她。真不要脸。”

好....说我不要脸是吧。

糖嫣伸手指着刘施施，放狠话：“好，刘施施。我原本不打算做什么，现在是你逼我的！！”

“我糖嫣把话放这里。魏沐我睡定了，谁也留不住他！！”

“你再说一遍！！”

炸了炸了，刘施施炸了，她像个愤怒的小狮子，冲了过去。

幸好杨蜜眼疾手快，把她拦腰抱住。

眼见刘施施冲不过来，刚被吓退好几步的糖嫣继续输出。

“对，我不仅睡你的男人还要抢你的角色，你还要眼睁睁看着...”

抱着瞎姐腰的杨蜜脸色涨红，她没想到这姑娘力气这么大。

“糖糖，你少说两句，我快拦不住她...”

“拜拜。”

向杨蜜投去一个感谢的眼神，糖嫣赶紧闪人。

刚才骂爽了，心情不错的中戏之耻从休息棚内走出来。

见她出来，胡哥赶紧上去问：“你没事吧？”

“没事呀。”

糖嫣一愣，然后露出标志的傻白甜笑容。

“我能有什么事，下午见....”

看着女人离开的背影，袁红和老胡对视一眼，满脑子问号。

另一边，还在休息棚的刘施施气呼呼地坐下来，一双死鱼眼狠狠瞪着杨蜜。

“你干嘛拦着我？”

“姑奶奶，我要是不拦着，今天就要出大事。”

Faced with Tang Yan's cold questioning, Liu Shishi responded directly.

"I'm telling the truth. Also, do other people's lunch boxes smell that good?"

"Liu Shishi, do you have a problem with your understanding? Wei Mu and I really have nothing to do with each other."

She said this sentence many times.

Blind sister doesn’t believe it!!

The main reason is that Tang Yan is so annoying. This woman plays a couple with Wei Mu every day, flirting with her on the set, and deliberately showing off in front of her.

Who would believe it if he said he didn’t put any thought into it?

Yang Mi sat like a quail between the two of them, not daring to breathe.

This situation was somewhat beyond her control.

As an outsider, she would be happy to see the two of them quarreling.

But now she is in the middle of the game and it is not easy to sit back and watch.

It's like a passerby who comes to watch the excitement, only to find out when he gets there that his house is on fire.

"Oops. We are all colleagues in the same crew. Please calm down."

As a last resort, Yang Mi came out to smooth things over.

"Mimi, to be fair, wasn't she the one who provoked me first today?"

Tang Yan felt aggrieved. She had done nothing today and was insulted for no reason.

how?I eat your rice now that I’m old?

"Tell her to stay away from my boyfriend and I won't care about her."

"Haha..."

The blind sister glared at her, then shook Yang Mi's arm angrily: "Look at her. She's so shameless."

Okay...you'd say I'm shameless, right?

Tang Yan pointed at Liu Shishi and said harshly: "Okay, Liu Shishi. I didn't plan to do anything originally, but now you are forcing me!!"

"I, Tang Yan, put my words here. Wei Mu is ready to sleep, no one can keep him!!"

"Say it again!!"

Exploded, exploded, Liu Shishi exploded, she rushed over like an angry little lion.

Fortunately, Yang Mi had quick eyes and quick hands and grabbed her waist and hugged her.

Seeing that Liu Shishi couldn't rush forward, Tang Yan, who had just been scared back a few steps, continued her output.

"Yes, not only do I sleep with your man, but I also steal your role, and you also watch helplessly..."

Yang Mi, who was holding the blind sister's waist, turned red. She didn't expect this girl to be so strong.

"Tangtang, please stop saying a few words, I won't be able to stop her anymore..."

"Bye."

Casting a grateful look at Yang Mi, Tang Yan quickly stepped out of the way.

Zhongxi Shame, who had just finished scolding and was in a good mood, walked out of the lounge.

Seeing her come out, Brother Hu quickly went up and asked, "Are you okay?"

"It's okay."

Tang Yan was stunned for a moment, then showed her trademark silly and sweet smile.

"What can I do for you? See you in the afternoon..."

Watching the woman leave, Yuan Hong and Lao Hu looked at each other, their minds filled with questions.

On the other side, Liu Shishi, who was still in the rest shed, sat down angrily and glared at Yang Mi with a pair of dead fish eyes.

"Why are you stopping me?"

"Auntie, if I don't stop you, something big will happen today."
